title: Reproducibility Report for SC25 Paper ThirstyFLOPS: Water Footprint Modeling and Analysis Toward Sustainable HPC Systems
problem: Evaluating sustainability metrics and water footprint models for HPC systems requires independent reproducibility assessment.
motivation: SC25 Reproducibility Initiative validates research methodologies and enables community replication of sustainability measurements.
method: Artifact evaluation of ThirstyFLOPS paper examining water usage modeling for HPC systems. Assessment conducted by SC25 Reproducibility Committee.
key_novelty: Reproducibility assessment of water footprint modeling for HPC sustainability.
contributions: Validation of water footprint modeling methodology
Assessment of artifact quality and documentation
limitations: Report focuses on artifact evaluation rather than technical contributions; specific findings depend on ThirstyFLOPS paper; sustainability evaluation depends on system-specific parameters.
